title: Sum over subsets of a two-element set
statement: For any real-valued function $F$ on the subsets of $\{0,1\}$, the sum of $F(U)$ over all such subsets is $F(\varnothing)+F(\{0\})+F(\{1\})+F(\{0,1\})$.
